label: Homeostasis and exchange
text: BI.O.A3.1 Homeostasis and exchange. Regulated variables are held in a range by negative feedback; not every internal value is constant. Exchange of gas, water, solute and heat is constrained by surface-to-volume ratio. Circulation and branching relieve that constraint. Chronobiology (circadian and other clocks) is a homeostatic-control claim and lives here. Normal human physiology is owned here; MD.O.A1 cites it.

warrant.standard: Controlled physiology or developmental perturbation; dose–response
